subject: red kidney beans
title: What If You Ate Undercooked Kidney Beans?

scenes.text: What if you ate undercooked kidney beans? A slow cooker might be the worst way to cook them.
Raw kidney beans carry a natural toxin called phytohaemagglutinin.
As few as four undercooked beans can bring on nausea, cramps and vomiting within hours.
Boiling at full heat for at least ten minutes destroys the toxin.
But many slow cookers only reach about 167 degrees Fahrenheit inside the food, not enough.
You'd usually recover in a few hours. Canned beans are already cooked, so they're safe.
